howItWorks.title: If you can send a message, you can use Sogio.

step1.title: You say it your way
step1.body: A voice note, a photo of the receipt, or plain text. No required fields, no menus, no screen to memorise.

step2.title: Sogio understands and logs it
step2.body: It picks out the property, the amount and the date, and files it in the right place. When it isn't sure, it asks before saving.

step3.title: You ask whenever you want
step3.body: How much came in this month? Did the country house turn a profit? The answer comes back with a number, right away.

item1.question: Does Sogio already work over WhatsApp?
item1.answer: Not yet. The Sogio dashboard is live and in use, and the conversational version is being built. That's why there's a waiting list instead of a sign-up button.

item2.question: What if it misunderstands me?
item2.answer: Before saving any amount, Sogio shows you what it understood and waits for your confirmation. If it's wrong, you say so in the same conversation and it fixes it.

item3.question: Is my financial data safe?
item3.answer: It stays in your account, encrypted, and is never sold or shared. And it's yours: you can export everything at any time and delete your account whenever you want, without talking to anyone.

item4.question: Do I need to install anything or be good with technology?
item4.answer: No. If you send messages and voice notes on WhatsApp, you already know enough, and there's no new screen to learn. The Sogio dashboard still works for people who like seeing everything on a screen, but it's optional.

item5.question: What if everything is already in a spreadsheet?
item5.answer: Send the spreadsheet in the conversation and Sogio imports the history. You don't start from scratch.

item6.question: Is it useful if I only have one property?
item6.answer: Yes. Sogio is built for people looking after 1 to 15 short-term rentals, from a single beach flat to a small portfolio.

item7.question: Does it work with Airbnb and Booking?
item7.answer: Yes. You can log bookings from any platform or from direct rentals and reconcile everything in one place.
